name: MH Security/guarantee bond — REFUSES: encoded text is superseded
source_note: Art 54 was substituted by Mah. 7 of 2022 (20-1-2022). The 0.5%/Rs 10L cap this case used to assert is the PRIOR text, which the source PDF prints in a footnote. Until the current text (0.1% / 0.3%, max Rs 20 lakh) is encoded and verified, the engine must refuse rather than return superseded law.
